Frontend Playwright on the live preview URL: login OK, Dashboard 'Campaign Activity' is the FIRST left-column block with data-testid='campaign-activity-section', exactly 4 row testids rendered, 'View All' button navigates to /campaign, no Tawk on Dashboard or public /blog, /admin/blogs redirects non-admin to /dashboard, Campaign.jsx Send Range section + All/Custom radios + From/To inputs render and switch correctly, public /blog page renders (empty state — no published posts).

action_items: Path naming: align review brief vs implementation — endpoint is /api/accounts/{id}/credential (not /password). No code change needed unless rename is desired.
Manual smoke for the password-reveal toggle in the EmailAccounts Edit dialog after connecting an SMTP account (cannot be reached automatically since drip.tester has none).
Manual smoke for drip 'Add contacts' dialog Send Range section — backend slicing is verified end-to-end, frontend testids verified by source. Just open the dialog and confirm radios/inputs visually.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/server.py grew further to 6715 lines — the iter28 recommendation to split routers (blogs, campaigns, drips, accounts) is now even more pressing.

/api/admin/blogs/upload-image stores featured images as base64 data URIs in Mongo (line 5252+). Convenient but balloons db.blogs documents and JSON payloads — for any image > ~100KB the public list endpoint becomes heavy. Consider S3/static hosting before launch.

Drip add_drip_contacts (line 4639) clamps end to len(all_rows) and start to >=1; if start > end after clamping it returns an empty `selected_rows` silently. Consider 400 'invalid range' so the UI can surface it.

Standard campaign /campaigns POST builds the queue at /start time (range applied at line 909-914). A user editing the campaign with a smaller list later won't see the queue rebuilt — fine for MVP but worth documenting.

Slug generator falls back to `post-<6hex>` for empty titles — silently swallows a bad request rather than returning 400. Title is already required at the validator level so this branch is unreachable but the fallback adds noise.
GET /api/accounts/{id}/credential returns plaintext password as JSON. It is owner-scoped and over HTTPS, but consider audit-logging access events for SOC2 readiness.
